definitions.short: a testicle (as a cause of shame akin to fear)
definitions.full: H6344. pachad II. [ מַּ֫הַד ] noun [masculine] thigh (probably loan-word (through Aramaic, otherwise = ז ) from Arabic thigh and (compare We GGN, 1893, 479 ) sub-tribe , Palmyrene פחד tribe ); — פַחְדּוֺ גִּידֵי Job 40:17 Kt the sinews of his thigh (Qr מְּחָדָיו ), of hippopotamus.
